business_summary: DSP Blackrock Mutual Fund - DSP BlackRock Nifty 50 ETF is an exchange traded fund co-launched by DSP ADIKO Holdings Pvt. Ltd, DSP HMK Holdings Pvt. Ltd, and BlackRock, Inc. It is managed by DSP BlackRock Investment Managers Pvt. Ltd. The fund invests in the public equity markets of India. It seeks to invest in the stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. The fund invests in the stocks of large-cap companies. It seeks to replicate the performance of the Nifty 50 Index, by investing in the stocks of companies as per their weightings in the index. DSP Blackrock Mutual Fund - DSP BlackRock Nifty 50 ETF is domiciled in India.
